theorem sum_R3W {α x δ Q : ℝ} {a k : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hx : 0 < x) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hcop : IsCoprime a (q : ℤ)) (h2α : 2 * α = a / q + δ / x + k) (hqQ : (q : ℝ) ≤ Q)
    (hδ : |δ / x| * (q * Q) ≤ 1) {R D : ℝ} (hR1 : 1 ≤ R) (hRq : (q : ℝ) / 2 ≤ R) (hRD : R < D) :
    ∑ n ∈ Ioc ⌊R⌋ ⌊D⌋, Real.log n * Tn α x n ≤
      3 * (1 + eta2'L1 / (x / D)) / 2 * x *
          (Real.log (3 * R) / R + Real.log D / q * Real.log (D / R)) +
        2 * √(c₀ * (1 + eta2'L1 / (x / D))) / π *
          (q * √3 * Real.log (3 * R) + (D * (Real.log D - 1) - R * (Real.log R - 1)) +
            2 * q * Real.log (D / R) + q / 2 * Real.log D * Real.log (D / R)) :=

note: The book weights each block by its lower end log(jq+R), which does not bound log m on the block; Lean uses the upper end, so the j=0 term is (x/R)log(R+q) (≤ (x/R)log 3R for R ≥ q/2). Typo: After (4.61) the book cites the assumption x >= e^2 c/2 (the lemma states x >= e^2 c_2/2 = 2.481); (checked by `scripts/checks/eq_4_61.py`).
